purpose: Compare a centralized critic with the trained shared PPO baseline under the navigation-prior and reward-scale recipe that showed a modest development learning signal.
critic_information: Joint aircraft observations, alive flags and target identity; deployed actor remains local.
capacity_caveat: Both critics have two 256-wide hidden layers, but joint input increases MAPPO critic parameters. This is not a parameter-count-matched information-only ablation.
controls: Identical actor tensors and reconstructed learner RNG before the first rollout; same world seeds, action mapping, reward recipe, support flags and optimization settings.
initial_evaluation: Evaluate the MAPPO initial checkpoint explicitly, despite matching PPO actor weights.
limitations: One development seed; no claim of general MAPPO superiority.
Three canonical seeds and unseen scenarios remain required.
No matrix rows or competition evaluations are altered.
